problem: Verify Nightlogue Conductor automatically requests a Codex review on a bot-created draft PR after successful agent branch CI, without needing a human comment.
solution: Add a temporary documentation-only smoke check branch. Inspect the trusted handoff's PR, bot-authored comment, Codex response and review completion. Close the PR without merging.
tests: GitHub Actions full branch CI must complete successfully
Inspect automatically created GitHub App draft PR and match its exact CI commit
Verify the @codex review comment is authored by nightlogue-conductor[bot] and Codex responds
risks: Do not merge this documentation-only test. Codex may ignore requests authored by GitHub Apps; if so leave auto-review unverified and disable the faulty trigger rather than retrying repeatedly.
review: Confirm the PR has the UICOMP-11 problem statement, one GitHub App-authored review request for the tested SHA, a Codex acknowledgment or receipt, and no automatic merge.
